package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/course"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// CourseI18nHandler handles course localization.
type CourseI18nHandler struct {
	Validator      *validator.Validate
	UpsertUC       course.UpsertCourseI18n
	DeleteUC       course.DeleteCourseI18n
	ListUC         course.ListI18n
	ListByCourseUC course.ListCourseI18n
}

type courseI18nRequest struct {
	I18nID      int    `json:"i18n_id" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Title       string `json:"title" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Description string `json:"description" validate:"required"`
}

// Create handles POST /course-i18n/create/{courseID}.
func (h CourseI18nHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	var req courseI18nRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	entry, err := h.UpsertUC.Handle(r.Context(), course.UpsertCourseI18nInput{
		CourseID:    courseID,
		I18nID:      req.I18nID,
		Title:       req.Title,
		Description: req.Description,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"course_id": entry.CourseID, "i18n_id": req.I18nID})
}

// Update handles PUT /course-i18n/update/{courseID}/{i18nID}.
func (h CourseI18nHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	i18nID := chi.URLParam(r, "i18nID")
	var req courseI18nRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if i18nID != "" {
		parsedI18nID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(i18nID, "i18nID")
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		req.I18nID = parsedI18nID
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	entry, err := h.UpsertUC.Handle(r.Context(), course.UpsertCourseI18nInput{
		CourseID:    courseID,
		I18nID:      req.I18nID,
		Title:       req.Title,
		Description: req.Description,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"course_id": entry.CourseID, "i18n_id": req.I18nID})
}

// Delete handles DELETE /course-i18n/delete/{courseID}/{i18nID}.
func (h CourseI18nHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	rawI18nID := chi.URLParam(r, "i18nID")
	if courseID == "" || rawI18nID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "courseID and i18nID required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	i18nID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(rawI18nID, "i18nID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), courseID, i18nID); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// ListI18n handles GET /i18n/list.
func (h CourseI18nHandler) ListI18n(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	items, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context())
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	response := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		response = append(response, map[string]any{
			"id":   item.ID,
			"lang": item.Language,
		})
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"languages": response})
}

// ListByCourse handles GET /course-i18n/list/{courseID}.
func (h CourseI18nHandler) ListByCourse(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	courseID := chi.URLParam(r, "courseID")
	if courseID == "" {
		http.Error(w, "courseID required", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	items, err := h.ListByCourseUC.Handle(r.Context(), courseID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	response := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		response = append(response, map[string]any{
			"course_id":   item.CourseID,
			"i18n_id":     item.I18nID,
			"title":       item.Title,
			"description": item.Description,
		})
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"items": response})
}
